title: PROFESSOR JOHN MEARSHEIMER: THE CRISIS IN UKRAINE
summary: A King's Politics interview with University of Chicago professor John Mearsheimer, recorded days before Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022. He lays out the realist argument about NATO expansion and Russia's view of Ukraine.
why: Cited during the 2022 invasion threads as the realist expert position on the Ukraine crisis, though some commenters see it as Russian apologism.

quote.text: you’ll probably find it in this very straightforward talk by John Mearsheimer on this very conflict.
